title: Comparable

inlines.v: COMPARABLE, adjective That may be compared; worthy of comparison; being of equal regard; that may be estimated as equal. There is no blessing of life comparable to the enjoyment of a discreet and virtuous friend. The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold. Lamentations 4:2.
